name: kiwishare-monorepo
description: Monorepo for KiwiShare - Mobile App (Flutter) and Backend Cloud Functions (Koa + TypeScript)

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --ignore-scripts && cd mobile && flutter pub get
scripts.mobile:format: cd mobile && dart format --set-exit-if-changed lib/ test/
scripts.mobile:dev: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && cd mobile && flutter run
scripts.mobile:dev:device: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && cd mobile && flutter run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1 || echo localhost):3000
scripts.test:all: pnpm run mobile:test && pnpm run functions:test
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run mobile:analyze && pnpm run functions:lint
